name: Octree-based Bounding Volume Computation
definition: An alternative strategy to compute bounding volumes by decomposing space into an octree and computing the convex hull from straddling cubes.
summary: Octree-based Bounding Volume Computation computes a convex hull from straddling cubes in an adaptive octree, offering faster convergence for anisotropic shapes but lacking the surface enclosure guarantees of Sphere Carving.
